title: Iconic
sources:
- MINI USA Countryman Electric: https://www.miniusa.com/model/electric-vehicles/countryman.html
- Edmunds 2025 Countryman Electric Iconic: https://www.edmunds.com/mini/countryman/2025/electric/
- InsideEVs 2025 SE ALL4 pricing/specs: https://insideevs.com/news/729369/2025-mini-countryman-se-all4-pricing-specs-overview/
- IIHS 2025 Countryman ratings: https://www.iihs.org/ratings/vehicle/mini/countryman-4-door-suv/2025
- Consumer Reports first drive: https://www.consumerreports.org/cars/hybrids-evs/2025-mini-countryman-se-review-a1124603539/
- TopSpeed 2025 SE ALL4 review: https://www.topspeed.com/2025-mini-countryman-se-review/
- MINI USA warranty: https://www.miniusa.com/owners/service-support/warranties.html
infotainment: MINI Operating System 9 on 9.4-inch circular OLED touchscreen, AR Navigation, Harman Kardon premium sound.
adasStandard: Everything in Signature Plus PLUS: Driving Assistant Plus (lane-keeping assist, lane-change assist, traffic-jam assist for hands-on highway use up to ~37 mph), Parking Assistant Plus (surround-view 360 camera, automated parallel/perpendicular park-in/park-out, Reversing Assistant that retraces last 50m of forward path). Interior Camera (cabin selfie/security cam). Source: https://www.edmunds.com/mini/countryman/2025/electric/
adasOptional: No further ADAS options above Iconic baseline for MY25. Driving Assistant Professional (the hands-free highway assist that competes with BlueCruise/Super Cruise) is NOT offered on the MY25 SE ALL4 in the US. Source: https://www.miniusa.com/model/electric-vehicles/countryman.html
rearViewCameraNotes: Standard color rearview camera with dynamic guide-line overlays integrated into the 9.4-inch circular OLED touchscreen. Source: https://www.edmunds.com/mini/countryman/2025/electric/
sideViewCameraNotes: Surround-view 360-degree camera (Top View / Panorama View) standard on Iconic via Parking Assistant Plus. Includes 3D view of vehicle. No Honda-LaneWatch-style passenger-side blind-spot camera; no integrated trailer-camera view. Source: https://www.edmunds.com/mini/countryman/2025/electric/
subscriptionFeatures: MINI Connected Plus subscription (same terms as Signature Plus). Iconic includes the Harman Kardon premium audio (one-time hardware, not subscription) and Augmented Reality Navigation (one-time, not subscription). Remote Engine Start subscription handled the same way. Source: https://www.motoringfile.com/2025/04/30/miniusa-says-no-thanks-to-expanding-software-subscriptions-for-now/
drmNotes: Identical to Signature Plus: car drives and charges fully offline; cellular link only needed for MINI Connected Plus features, OTA updates, and eCall. Iconic adds Augmented Reality Navigation (uses front camera overlay on infotainment for turn cues) — degrades to standard nav when offline but core map/route still works from on-board map data. Source: https://www.miniusa.com/why-mini/mini-connected-technology.html
killSwitchNotes: No impaired-driving interlock or remote kill switch. Driver Attention Camera (standard) provides drowsiness/distraction warnings only. NHTSA's IIJA Section 24220 rule is not yet finalized. Source: https://www.theautopian.com/new-cars-sold-in-america-will-be-actively-watching-and-judging-you-and-may-decide-to-not-let-you-drive/
knownIssues: Same MY25-cohort patterns as Signature Plus: nested-menu UX friction noted in Consumer Reports first drive. Iconic adds the Driver Attention Camera-based Interior Camera and AR Nav, neither of which has yet generated owner-forum issue clusters at <12 months on market. Source: https://www.consumerreports.org/cars/hybrids-evs/2025-mini-countryman-se-review-a1124603539/
recalls: Data unavailable: same constraint as Signature Plus — searched NHTSA recall database for 2025 MINI Countryman SE ALL4; no SE-ALL4-specific recall record was retrievable at search time. Owners should check NHTSA.gov by VIN.
stateIncentives: Same as Signature Plus: no federal purchase credit (non-NA assembly); $7,500 lease passthrough expired 2025-09-30 with the broader IRA EV-credit termination; state incentives apply where individually qualified. At MSRP $48,600, exceeds CO base-credit MSRP cap and NY Drive Clean cap. Sources: https://www.miniramsey.com/blog/2025/august/2/federal-ev-tax-credit-due-to-expire.htm ; https://www.billjacobsmini.com/which-mini-cooper-is-eligible-for-the-ev-7500-lease-credit/
tcoSource:
Primary: CarEdge MINI Countryman (https://caredge.com/mini/countryman/costs) — 5-year total $51,909; depreciation $22,852 (from $45,650 new to ~$22,798), insurance $10,790 ($2,158/yr), financing $7,127 (72mo @ 6.99% APR, 20% down), maintenance+repairs $2,585 combined (split ~60/40 to $1,551 maintenance / $1,034 repairs).

Fuel adjustment: CarEdge's $8,555 fuel figure uses 27 MPG (gas Countryman). The Countryman Electric (SE) is fully BEV — recalculated using ~3.5 mi/kWh, 15k mi/yr, ~$0.165/kWh → ~$440/yr × 5 = $2,200. Depreciation, insurance, and financing inherited from the gas Countryman baseline because no electric-specific CarEdge breakdown is published; Iconic Electric MSRP is higher (~$45,200), so depreciation will trend higher and fuel lower.

Supplementary: KBB (https://www.kbb.com/mini/countryman-se-electric/2025/) listed but no public cost-to-own breakdown for the Electric variant. Edmunds (https://www.edmunds.com/mini/countryman-electric/2025/cost-to-own/) blocked via WebFetch (403). Taxes & fees not itemized; omitted.

title: Signature Plus
sources:
- MINI USA Countryman Electric: https://www.miniusa.com/model/electric-vehicles/countryman.html

- EV Charging Stations DC fast-charging: https://evchargingstations.com/chargingnews/2025-mini-countryman-se-all4-dc-fast-charging-analysis/
- IIHS 2025 Countryman ratings: https://www.iihs.org/ratings/vehicle/mini/countryman-4-door-suv/2025
- Consumer Reports first drive: https://www.consumerreports.org/cars/hybrids-evs/2025-mini-countryman-se-review-a1124603539/
exclusionReason: No side-view camera available (standard or optional)
infotainment: MINI Operating System 9 on 9.4-inch circular OLED touchscreen, Android Open Source Project base, app-store style. MINI Toggle Bar physical controls below screen.
adasStandard: Active Driving Assistant: Forward Collision Warning with City Collision Mitigation (autonomous emergency braking with pedestrian/cyclist detection), Lane Departure Warning, Speed Limit Info, Active Cruise Control with Stop & Go (adaptive cruise), Front Cross-Traffic Warning, Driver Attention Camera (drowsiness/distraction monitoring), Parking Assistant with rear PDC + Park Distance Control. Sources: https://www.edmunds.com/mini/countryman/2025/electric/st-402062485/features-specs/ ; https://www.miniusa.com/model/electric-vehicles/countryman.html
adasOptional: MINI Driving Assistant Plus (Driving Assistant Professional in Iconic — see Iconic trim). On Signature Plus, the upgrade is bundled into the Iconic trim rather than offered as a standalone option. Sources: https://www.edmunds.com/mini/countryman/2025/electric/st-402062485/features-specs/
rearViewCameraNotes: Standard color rearview camera with dynamic guide-line overlays integrated into the 9.4-inch circular OLED touchscreen. Resolution not officially specified, but is the BMW Group OS9 shared-stack camera (same hardware as iX1/iX2). Source: https://www.edmunds.com/mini/countryman/2025/electric/st-402062485/features-specs/
sideViewCameraNotes: Surround-view 360-degree camera (Top View) is included as part of the Driving Assistant Plus / Parking Assistant Plus bundle on the Iconic trim, not standard on Signature Plus. No Honda-LaneWatch-style passenger-side blind-spot camera; no integrated trailer view. Source: https://www.edmunds.com/mini/countryman/2025/electric/st-402062485/features-specs/
subscriptionFeatures: MINI Connected Plus (monthly or annual; price varies by region, typically ~$10-25/mo or ~$100-250/yr per BMW Group North America patterns) — includes live traffic, augmented-reality navigation extras (Iconic trim only), in-car app store, advanced remote services. Remote Engine Start subscription, separately. MINI USA stated April 2025 it has no plans to expand subscription-gated software in the US (no heated-seats-as-a-service, no horsepower-as-a-service). When a subscription lapses, the feature simply becomes unavailable — no impact on car operation. Source: https://www.motoringfile.com/2025/04/30/miniusa-says-no-thanks-to-expanding-software-subscriptions-for-now/
drmNotes: Car drives and charges fully offline. Cellular link is needed for: MINI Connected Plus subscription features (live navigation traffic, in-car streaming, Remote Engine Start via app, advanced telematics), Over-the-Air updates, and emergency-call eCall. No essential driving feature (range estimate, drive modes, climate, infotainment touchscreen, CarPlay/AndroidAuto via phone Bluetooth/USB) requires connectivity. OTA updates are delivered via MINI's Remote Software Upgrade pipeline (shared with BMW), opt-in. No public report of MINI remotely disabling a working feature post-sale. Sources: https://www.miniusa.com/why-mini/mini-connected-technology.html ; https://faq.miniusa.com/s/article/FAQ-Will-my-my-2025-MINI-Cooper-2-Door-receive-regular-Remote-Software-Upgrades-HDW5g?language=en_US
killSwitchNotes: No impaired-driving interlock or remote kill switch. The Driver Attention Camera (standard) provides drowsiness/distraction warnings only and cannot prevent the car from operating. NHTSA's IIJA Section 24220 rule is not yet finalized as of 2026-05; no MINI-specific compliance path has been announced for this MY25 vehicle. Source: https://www.theautopian.com/new-cars-sold-in-america-will-be-actively-watching-and-judging-you-and-may-decide-to-not-let-you-drive/
knownIssues: Too new for established failure patterns — production began mid-2024, in-service ~6-12 months by 2026-05. Consumer Reports first drive noted the round-screen interface 'befuddles' some users with deep-menu controls for common functions (heated seats, mirror folding) accessed through nested touchscreen menus rather than physical switches. Source: https://www.consumerreports.org/cars/hybrids-evs/2025-mini-countryman-se-review-a1124603539/
recalls: Data unavailable: searched NHTSA recall database for 2025 MINI Countryman; campaigns covering ICE-Countryman OS9 software issues may affect SE ALL4 but no SE-ALL4-specific recall record was retrievable at search time. Owners should check NHTSA.gov by VIN. Source: https://cars.usnews.com/cars-trucks/mini/cooper/2025/reliability
stateIncentives: Built in Leipzig, Germany — does not meet North American final-assembly requirement, so no federal IRC 30D credit for purchase. The federal commercial-leasing loophole (IRC 45W) made the SE ALL4 eligible for a $7,500 leasing-passthrough until that program expired September 30, 2025. State incentives vary: California CVRP discontinued late 2023; Colorado offered up to $5,000 for BEVs in 2025; NJ offers sales-tax exemption; NY Drive Clean Rebate up to $2,000 if MSRP <$42k (SE ALL4 ineligible at $45.2k base). Sources: https://www.miniramsey.com/blog/2025/august/2/federal-ev-tax-credit-due-to-expire.htm ; https://www.billjacobsmini.com/which-mini-cooper-is-eligible-for-the-ev-7500-lease-credit/
